title: Plan dashboard authoring actions from catalog rows
summary: Break down dashboard actions for create fixture, inspect closure, compare variants, open samples, run smokes, and navigate source/test refs from agenda rows.

sourceRefs.summary: Agenda-style dashboard rendering and preview behavior.

expectedLearning: Which authoring actions are safe as static links versus which require an authenticated or local action runner.
How rows should report maturity, blockers, source refs, and verification after actions run.
How future Codex sessions should write back completion state without hand-editing dashboard data.
allowedWork: Define the dashboard action contract and split implementation into small slices.
Prefer actions that open existing samples, tests, and source refs before mutation actions.
Keep one-row agenda navigation as the dominant layout.
disallowedWork: Do not return to card-heavy dashboard sections.
Do not add writeback mutation actions before source refs and verification reporting are stable.
Do not make the dashboard depend on live browser-only state for static catalog rendering.
revisitWhen: After the promoted transform library gives dashboard rows concrete semantic definitions to operate on.
